summary: Collective Mining Ltd. filed a Form 6-K with a press release dated August 25, 2026, reporting metallurgical test results for its Apollo system at the Guayabales Project in Colombia. The tests showed high recovery rates—95% gold, 92% silver, 85% copper, and up to 74% tungsten—using conventional methods. The company plans to release a maiden mineral resource estimate in September 2026 and accelerated its timeline to apply for a project license. No transaction, takeover, or corporate action is involved; this is a routine operational update.
